name: qdq_q_ref-q1-COMMIT
purpose: ot_hgi_qdq_q B2 quarter cluster via ref_tile: track-B decoder (dxl/dbq/daq hard tiles, CLOSED views) + result FIFO on one 64x512 SRAM macro (2-entry registered prefetch; was a 64x512 flop array read 64:1), W face = slice read lanes, N face = slice write lanes, S = dispatch rec/ret, clock spine

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qdq_q #(.DEC3(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_HARD_CHILDREN --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/link/ot_fifo_sram_fwft.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/ot_hgi_quant_record.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/ot_hgi_qw_dec3.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/ot_hgi_qdq_q.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qdq_q_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qdq_q_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qdq_q_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qdq_q --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qw_daq_ref/views/ot_hgi_qw_daq --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qw_dbq_ref/views/ot_hgi_qw_dbq --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qw_dxl_ref/views/ot_hgi_qw_dxl > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

no_bench_reason: bench = tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_q.sh (needs the B2 slice + qdqvec vectors) S=3 PASS 169/168 = 1.006x, S=1 161/168, m1/m2 FAIL at the source commit; record results/rtl/tput_map_1011/ds_qdq_b2
